title: Three session transcripts hydrate 63 of 64 expected tail entries after a Central restart
outcome: After a restart every session transcript tail hydrates completely, or the gap is explained by a correct design rule and reported without a warning.
acceptance: Disposable regression evidence reproduces an incomplete remote-proxy tail, a one-message read-through fetch and a subsequent reload through the existing loader, hydration and persistence owners; it establishes whether every original peer message remains fetchable and whether a full tail fetch survives reload.

The confirmed cause is corrected: permitted sparse proxy caches have an accurate boot hydration state and diagnostic, or any demonstrated unrecoverable content is restored. Regression evidence preserves peer-message fetchability, local-corruption quarantine and invalid-remote-response refusals, and the change has a clean review pair.
